title: Accept events before downstream processing
body: The MIRA event endpoint acknowledges accepted events immediately and processes them asynchronously. External senders are not coupled to downstream processing time.

attributes.statement: MIRA accepts inbound events with 202 and processes them asynchronously.
attributes.rationale: Event producers should not remain coupled to MIRA's processing latency or downstream availability. Immediate acknowledgement allows the ingestion boundary to remain reliable while processing continues independently.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Process the event synchronously before responding
alternatives_rejected.reason: It couples external event delivery to downstream processing latency and failure.
